entry.note: Identified from the arXiv title page (arXiv:0902.0350v1, math.MG, 2 Feb 2009): Hales, Harrison, McLaughlin, Nipkow, Obua, Zumkeller, 'A revision of the proof of the Kepler conjecture', 41 pp. No ref() entry existed before this triage (references.ts had no Kepler / sphere-packing entry; its only 'kissing' match was the surname Kissinger). Entry hales-etal2010 created 2026-09-06; no citation site yet — bib orphan pending the cite-in-block bean.

relevance.rationale: Corpus-grepped before judging: docs/audits/2026-09-05-max-contact-sub-affine-negative.md §5 states outright that 'references.ts has no packing entry' and that the Harborth/Bezdek/contact-number/sphere-packing forms were 'deliberately not cited' because nothing was held; rem:bk-coordination-multiplicity (lines 83-86) and QOU.Mass.CoordinationSaturation nonetheless appeal to 'a geometric close-packing count' / 'the close-packing / fcc picture'. This document is now the held source for the ONE thing it actually establishes for the folio: the Kepler theorem statement (Introduction, p. 2 — no packing of congruent balls in E^3 exceeds the fcc density), i.e. that fcc is the density-optimal reference configuration the coordination arc names. It does not prove the kissing number 12 or any contact-number bound (those are Schütte–van der Waerden 1953 and bezdek-reid2013 Theorem 1), so it cannot by itself source the bounded-degree k = 12 of prop:coordination-saturation. Part 1 (§1–§7: Flyspeck, HOL Light / Isabelle formalisation of the nonlinear inequalities, tame-graph enumeration, LP verification) is a methodological precedent for this repository's blueprint-then-formalise discipline but supplies no mathematics the folio consumes; Part 2 (§8 biconnected graphs, §9 errata) is internal to the Kepler proof. Not 'core': the corpus records four standing objections to importing Euclidean packing geometry at all (internal derivation demanded by qou-rav3; ambient geometry hyperbolic; three-dimensionality underived; exponent imported) and a citation makes the import citable, not derived. Scope-(a): as read, the usable content is the density statement and nothing else.

keyResults.locator: Introduction, p. 2 (statement); §2 blueprint edition; Part 2 §8–§9 errata to the 2005 proof
keyResults.statement: No packing of congruent balls in three-dimensional Euclidean space has density greater than the face-centred cubic packing; the paper records the reorganised (blueprint) proof and the errata to the original.
keyResults.useForFolio: Gives rem:bk-coordination-multiplicity's 'geometric close-packing count' and prop:coordination-saturation's fcc picture a held citation for the density-optimality of fcc. It does not supply the coordination bound itself (see bezdek-reid2013) and does not touch the corpus's four objections to the geometric import.

The close-packing / fcc appeal in rem:bk-coordination-multiplicity and the CoordinationSaturation Lean docstring is unsourced; cite the density statement here and the contact bound from bezdek-reid2013 in the same edit (one combined bean for the two packing sources).
